extDescription: Ask AI about the page you're reading: summaries, explanations and translations without leaving Safari.
emptyTitle: What would you like to know?

consentBody: You give it once, for all of ContextFlow's AI. Each feature sends only what it needs, when you use it, via our server to Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (backup answers, suggestions) and Google Gemini (Google answers). With your own API key, it goes straight to that provider. Nothing is kept on our servers; no one trains on it.
consentAnswers: Answers: your question, the page's text or your selection, and your “About me” if you wrote one. If Claude is unavailable, OpenAI answers; Google answers go to Google Gemini.
consentChats: “Ask your chats” and AI search (Pro): short excerpts of your chats.
consentTemplates: Templates: their text, to mark the blanks; the page's text for “Fill from the page”; your words and the templates' titles for “Find by meaning”.
consentWatch: Watching a page: what you selected, your words for when to tell you, the text around it and the page's title; later, the old and the new value.
consentSuggest: Suggestions (Pro, only once you turn them on): the text of new questions, answers and notes, to OpenAI to compare them and to Claude to check a tag.
consentStored: Your chats stay on your devices and, if you sync them, in your iCloud.
consentAgainTitle: Updated: one consent for all AI features
consentNeeded: Nothing was sent: AI answers need your consent first.
setFabHint: The ✦ button opens ContextFlow on any site. Hide it on a single site with the link below, or turn it off here.
setAboutHint: Optional. Helps tailor answers, e.g. “I'm a product designer, keep it short”.
setOwnKeyHint: Included in Pro and Own key plans. Paste an OpenAI or Anthropic (Claude) key; requests go straight from your device to that provider.
setOwnKeyLocked: Available with Pro or Own key plan
setOwnKeyModelHint: Fast: newest Claude Haiku or GPT mini. Smart: newest Claude Sonnet or GPT.
setSyncChatsHint: Continue a chat on your iPhone, iPad and Mac. The chat is end-to-end encrypted in your iCloud and never stored on our servers.
googleModeHint: Answer with Google Search: fresh facts with sources
tourAskBody: ContextFlow reads the page you're on; with Pro, also the videos with captions and the PDFs on it. Pick an action like Summarize, or type your own question.
tourSelectBody: Select text on the page first, and the answer is about just that. This label shows what ContextFlow reads.
tourGoogleBody: Turn this on to answer with Google Search: current information with sources.
tourChatsBody: A chat carries on from page to page. Start a new one with +, and open, rename or delete earlier ones in the chat list. Tap a page's name in the chat to go back to it.
tourChatsBodySync: A chat carries on from page to page, and on your iPhone, iPad and Mac through iCloud. Start a new one with +, and open, rename or delete earlier ones in the chat list. Tap a page's name in the chat to go back to it.
tourSettingsBody: Theme and text size, the ✦ button, a few words about you for better answers, your own API key and your plan. These tips are here too.
tourNoteBodyTouch: Swipe this button up or down to write a note instead of asking. It stays in the chat with its page and uses no answers.
tourNoteBodyMouse: Scroll on this button (or hold it) to write a note instead of asking. It stays in the chat with its page and uses no answers.
tourWholeBody: Turn on Whole chat when a question needs everything: all messages, your notes and the other pages of this chat. Off, answers use the last messages and this page.
tourMenuBody: Reminders and watched pages, Tips, Settings and this intro again are in this menu.
